pattern_name: GitLab Browser GoogleOauth2 CSRF Detected Banner (2026-07)
summary: Browser SSO to GitLab via Google can fail with 'Could not authenticate you from GoogleOauth2 because "Csrf detected"'; use token-based glab/curl access and only troubleshoot browser state if UI is required.

evidence.banner_text: Could not authenticate you from GoogleOauth2 because "Csrf detected".

notes: Prioritize PAT-based CLI/API access to keep working; if UI is mandatory, clear gitlab.com cookies, relax tracking protection, try private windows, and verify system time.
